title: Google Introduces AI Search Ads in India and 9 Other Countries
description: Google is implementing a significant change to its AI-driven search results by introducing advertisements in India and nine other countries. This update will commence in the fourth quarter of the year, allowing users to see ads related to their queries alongside or within the AI-generated responses.
